source.state: Local PR 122 follow-up changes accompanying this evidence

coverage: Existing graphics fallback, chunk/geometry failure, storage, GPU ownership, pause/resume and public shell checks
Three decoded worker PNGs in both themes, inverse stars, 2M pixels per layer, theme/resize races
Explicit Worker failure produces static CSS gradients with working navigation
Reduced-motion and hidden backdrop animation clocks
Held crystal freezes shader/simulation clocks and dims light; wake restores motion/light
Keyboard, pointer cancellation, window focus loss, touch policy, native Android Chromium CDP vertical swipe
Portrait/landscape navigation, search, theme persistence, responsive breakpoints
limitations: Desktop device emulation is not physical Android Chrome or iOS Safari hardware.
Window focus loss is delivered as a lifecycle event; automated headless tab switching does not certify native OS focus behavior.
Only the separate Apple M3 Max hardware capture qualifies frame timing for its recorded viewport.
Physical phone GPU timing, keyboard/browser chrome, sustained thermals and deployed Heroku smoke remain unverified; deployment is deferred.
